newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Vietnam awards 11 diesel, jet-kero cargoes for 1Q.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam awards 11 diesel, jet-kero cargoes for 1Q.

text.p: State-owned Vietnam National Petroleum Import-Export Corp (Petrolimex) has bought a total of 212,500 tonnes of gas oil, jet fuel and kerosene in its tender for January-March delivery, an industry source said on Tuesday.
It bought five cargoes on a free-on-board (fob) basis and six cargoes on cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis.
Prices of 1.0-percent sulphur gas oil on an fob Singapore basis was awarded at 15 cents per barrel above Singapore spot quotes, and for jet fuel at an 18-cent premium.
Cargoes of 0.5 and 1.0-percent sulphur for delivery to Ho Chi Minh City were awarded at 95 cents per barrel above Singapore spot quotes, c-and-f.
Cargoes of 1.0-percent sulphur gas oil for delivery to Hongai were awarded at $1.20 per barrel above Singapore spot quotes, c-and-f.
A small kerosene parcel which was combined with a gas oil cargo for delivery to Hongai was awarded at a $1.30-per-barrel premium to Singapore spot quotes, c-and-f.
The source said Petrolimex was still seeking another gas oil cargo for delivery in March.
In its last tender for fourth quarter 1996 delivery, Vietnam bought gas oil on an fob basis at 20 cents per barrel above Singapore spot quotes, and jet fuel at a 15-cent premium.
In the last tender gas oil cargoes on a c-and-f basis was awarded at a 95-cent premium to Singapore spot quotes to Ho Chi Minh City and a $1.10 per barrel premium for delivery to Hongai.
